build.compiler_version:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

chart_contract.bimodality: test, rather than assume, residual-ratio bimodality inside each palette hull with cell and pixel weights
chart_contract.hotspots: map ratio-classified occupied cells back to source pixels
chart_contract.mechanics: explain that Ward reduces Q to K while Lloyd moves K means
chart_contract.non_color_distinction: line style, marker shape, hatch, labels, and panel position
chart_contract.reachability: separate the convex-hull upper bound, experimental residual classifier, perceptual threshold, finite area, and palette spacing
chart_contract.visual_comparison: locate and show image regions whose per-pixel color error changes after final merge

protocol.batch_fence: one alpha-zero row and column between RGBA patches, using the production transparent-mask diffusion fence
protocol.geometric_domain: equal-volume occupied 1-unit CIELAB cells of this image; not the continuous RGB-cube volume
protocol.probe_representative: pixel-mass mean RGB rounded to uint8
protocol.purpose: compare geometric palette reachability with closed-loop FS reachability after final merge
protocol.ratio_classified_unreachable_definition: outside the linear-light palette hull, or inside the hull with residual divided by nearest-entry distance at least 0.5
protocol.ratio_classifier_status: experimental; ambiguity is measured and must be small before treating the threshold as a stable reachability metric
protocol.sensitivity_sample: union of 256 Lab-lexicographic evenly spaced cells and 256 highest-source-area cells
protocol.spatial_mean: arithmetic mean of emitted palette entries in linear-light sRGB, then CIELAB D65
